themes.consensus_view: Banks agree the AI-driven capital-spending boom is still intact and expanding, with hyperscaler build-out budgets climbing into 2027 and no meaningful pullback flagged yet.

facts_agreed.claim: The AI and tech capital-spending cycle remains intact and continues to build momentum.
evidence_quotes: The ongoing tech cycle continues to support capex momentum across Asia
record-breaking $26.5 billion listing by chipmaker SK Hynix helping to reinforce confidence

themes.consensus_view: Four banks flag renewed US-Iran tensions as a live macro risk this window, but none has staked a clear directional view on whether the conflict escalates or de-escalates.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple banks reference US-Iran conflict developments as an active risk to watch, spanning ceasefire fragility, fading diplomacy, and re-escalation.

themes.consensus_view: Four banks flag the 2026 FIFA World Cup as a spending catalyst worth watching for restaurants, travel, and consumer activity, but none has staked out a directional call on how big the boost will be.

facts_agreed.claim: Four banks reference the 2026 FIFA World Cup as an upcoming driver of consumer, restaurant, and travel spending.
evidence_quotes: World Cup impact on food away from home
FIFA World Cup 2026 impact on restaurant spending

themes.consensus_view: Goldman is the only desk staking a view, arguing that AI-driven price hikes in memory chips, software, and electricity are now measurably pushing up US core inflation, with the effect expected to grow.

facts_agreed.claim: AI-related price increases are adding a measurable amount to US core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred underlying inflation gauge.
evidence_quotes: adding more than 0.2pp to year-over-year core PCE inflation in the US

themes.consensus_view: Three banks reference Swift's blockchain pilot for cross-border payments and tokenized deposits as a live development, but none have staked a directional view on whether it succeeds or moves markets.

facts_agreed.claim: Goldman Sachs, HSBC, and JPMorgan all flag Swift's blockchain pilot as an active initiative in the cross-border payments and tokenized-deposit space.

themes.consensus_view: Three banks flag the US-Iran war as a supply-side driver of higher fuel prices and inflation, but none has staked a clear directional call on how large the hit will be.

facts_agreed.claim: Three banks reference the Iran conflict as an oil and fuel-price channel feeding into inflation.
evidence_quotes: War in Iran fuel price impact

themes.consensus_view: Three banks note that the Fed has stood up internal task forces covering leadership appointments, AI-driven productivity, and balance sheet and inflation, but none has staked out a directional market view on what these efforts will produce.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple banks reference new Fed internal task forces across leadership, AI-productivity, and balance-sheet/inflation topics as an emerging institutional development to track.
evidence_quotes: Fed task forces on AI-driven productivity
Fed task forces on balance sheet and inflation

themes.consensus_view: Two research desks read hyperscalers as financially healthy, seeing them as cheap versus their own history and able to fund their huge AI build-out from internal cash flow rather than borrowing.

facts_agreed.claim: Hyperscalers are in a sound financial position, attractively valued and able to self-fund their AI capex from operating cash.
evidence_quotes: Hyperscalers continue to look very cheap relative to history
we continue to expect Alphabet capex to be funded from internal operating cash generation
